name: @useyolo/dns-desec
description: Official Yolo DNS provider plugin: names the node's media listeners under a free deSEC name (dedyn.io) and answers their certificates' DNS-01 challenges

summary.en: A free deSEC name for direct play without a domain of your own.
summary.zh: 一个免费的 deSEC 名字，没有自己的域名也能直连播放。

privacy.en: Sends the node's addresses and certificate challenges to deSEC.
privacy.zh: 把节点的地址和证书验证发给 deSEC。
